summary: SCM inventory sources use source_project, source_path (blank = project root) and source_vars. Project updates trigger inventory updates, a project update runs right after source creation, neither is blocked by running jobs, and ~10 GB projects can fill /tmp.
questions: What is source_path for an SCM inventory source?
Does a project update trigger an inventory update?
Large project fills /tmp during inventory update
How do I pass environment variables to an SCM inventory?
